chapter.heading: Psalm 59
Deliver Me from My Enemies
To the choirmaster: according to Do Not Destroy. A Miktam(1) of David, when Saul sent men to watch his house in order to kill him.
chapter.v:
For behold,
they lie,
in wait for my life; fierce men stir up strife against me. For no transgression or sin of mine, O LORD,

for no
fault of,
mine, they run and make ready. Awake, come to meet me, and see!

You, LORD
God of,
hosts, are God of Israel. Rouse yourself to punish all the nations; spare none of those who treacherously plot evil. Selah
